hints.title: Digit Filtering
hints.text: Extract all non-zero decimal digits into a single concatenated string.

hints.title: Digit Summation
hints.text: Accumulate the sum of all digits from the original number.

hints.title: Product Calculation
hints.text: Multiply the concatenated integer value by the total digit sum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def concatenateAndMultiply(self, n: int) -> int:
        s = str(n)
        non_zero = "".join(c for c in s if c != '0')
        C = int(non_zero) if non_zero else 0
        S = sum(int(c) for c in s)
        return C * S
```

complexity.notes: Single pass string transformation and summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Redundant digit extraction passes add unnecessary overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct extraction of non-zero digits and multiplication by digit sum.
